parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity rows for JAK2. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Join docs on doc_id to obtain PubMed ID or DOI. Join compound_records on record_id to retrieve compound_key. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for JAK2 and activities.standard_type for IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
